designThesis: Northline sells make-slots, not mood boards: open on the Field Tote plate with trade facts on the plate edge; primary argument is hide grade via the Hide Grade Strip plus DKK 890–2.400 and a 3-week make-slot request — never lifestyle hero, purple SaaS gradient, or fake star rows.
subjectGrounding: Northline Leather Goods — small-batch bags and straps for buyers who care about hide grade. Products: Field Tote, Belt No. 2, Shoulder Strap. Materials: bridle leather, solid brass, vegetable tan. Price band DKK 890–2.400 (supplier sheet 2026-07). Make-slot lead time 3 weeks. Journey: pick product → choose hide → request make-slot. Mobile-first; density 6 / motion 2 / boldness 6. Brand: ink brown, warm cream, single brass accent; plain trade English. Must not invent: reviews, celebrity clients, free worldwide shipping. Anti-refs: purple SaaS gradient, stock handshake photos, fake 4.9★ rows.
composition: Mobile-first workshop desk stack: slim site bar → full-width Field Tote plate → material stamp line (bridle · vegetable tan · solid brass) → Hide Grade Strip → price band + 3-week lead → brass request-make-slot CTA → Belt No. 2 plate → Shoulder Strap as text row. Desktop widens the plate (~60%) and keeps hide chips + CTA as a sticky right rail — one desk, not magazine or poster type alone.
informationHierarchy: 1) Field Tote product plate 2) material stamp facts (bridle leather / vegetable tan / solid brass) 3) hide grade choice (Hide Grade Strip) 4) price band DKK 890–2.400 + 3-week lead time 5) primary CTA request a make-slot 6) Belt No. 2 plate 7) Shoulder Strap text/price until a plate exists — no testimonials, no fake star rows, no decorative process trophies.
typography: Display: Barlow Condensed 600–700 for product names (workshop signage, tight tracking). Body: IBM Plex Sans 400–500 for plain trade English at 45–75ch. Utility: IBM Plex Mono 400–500 for hide grades, stitch count, lead time, prices. No luxury serif display. Fallbacks: Arial Narrow / system-ui / ui-monospace.
colourAndMaterialModel: Warm cream ground; ink brown type and rules; single brass accent only on primary CTA and hardware callouts; materials in play: bridle leather, solid brass, vegetable tan. No purple, no multi-stop SaaS gradients, no neon-on-dark identity.
imageryAndAssetStrategy: Load-bearing plates: field-tote.webp and belt-no-2.webp on cream grounds, no model crops. stitch-macro.webp is needed-only proof inset near specs (not yet have). Shoulder Strap remains text + price until a plate is declared have. Deliberately no lifestyle models, stock handshakes, or review avatars.
interactionConcept: Primary journey is control, not scroll theatre: Hide Grade Strip as accessible radiogroup under the Field Tote plate; selection darkens the plate edge rail and updates the make-slot summary. Motion intensity 2: 120–180ms edge response on hide change; prefers-reduced-motion → instant swap. Fixed CTA copy: request a make-slot. No scroll-jacking, no ambient particles.
signatureElement: Hide Grade Strip — horizontal hide-grade chips (material swatch wells + ink-brown labels) under the Field Tote plate; the single control that binds plate → grade → make-slot request.
primaryRisk: Cream + brown leather ecommerce still collapses into generic artisan catalog if plates shrink and copy softens into luxury fluff; keep plate-first fold, stamp facts, mono measurements, make-slot language, and brass only on the CTA.
implementationGuidance: Tokenize cream / ink brown / brass; brass only on primary CTA and small hardware marks. Load only used weights of Barlow Condensed, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono. First paint at 375px: Field Tote plate under slim site bar. Radiogroup for hide grades with visible focus rings. CTA copy locked to request a make-slot. Specs limited to hide grade, materials, lead time 3 weeks, price band DKK 890–2.400, stitch count only if known. Absent Shoulder Strap plate → text row. Quality floor: focus visible, reduced-motion, no horizontal overflow, no invented social proof.
unknowns: Exact hide grade label set/codes not listed in evidence; stitch-macro.webp needed not have; Shoulder Strap plate not declared have; make-slot is a lead-time fact only — discrete calendar slots not specified.
